digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm review API / external live tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass and replaced with review_plan() and review_code(), causing AttributeError in four external live test CI lanes.
Two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) were not retargeted during the removal epic and remained calling the deleted review_ticket() API.
External tests are excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the removal epic's pytest run did not exercise these modules and the regression remained invisible until a live workflow_dispatch run.

review_plan() cannot replace review_ticket() in either test because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (without top-level findings) rather than REVIEW_RESULT (with runner/model/findings fields that the tests assert on).

Both test modules were retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() (the surviving op with REVIEW_RESULT contract) and validated live in workflow run 31856166064 with three LLM arms and langfuse tracing lane green.
